description: Manual-port AWS Lambda .NET 8 app (Cloud Migration Fortune API, independent reimplementation) + SAM template. Creates all source files under /Users/koji/kiro2/atoa/aws-lambda-manual/src/ and template.yaml at /Users/koji/kiro2/atoa/aws-lambda-manual/template.yaml. Independent of FEAT-001 and FEAT-003. HARD CONSTRAINT: must NOT reference /Users/koji/kiro2/atoa/aws-transform-output/ or /Users/koji/kiro2/atoa/aws-lambda-transform/ and must NOT use any Azure SDK.
steps: 1. Create /Users/koji/kiro2/atoa/aws-lambda-manual/src/MigrationFortuneManual.csproj. SDK=Microsoft.NET.Sdk, TargetFramework=net8.0, GenerateRuntimeConfigurationFiles=true, AWSProjectType=Lambda, Nullable=enable, ImplicitUsings=enable. NuGet packages: Amazon.Lambda.Core Version='2.*', Amazon.Lambda.APIGatewayEvents Version='2.*', Amazon.Lambda.Serialization.SystemTextJson Version='2.*', AWSSDK.S3 Version='3.*'. No Azure packages of any kind.

2. Create /Users/koji/kiro2/atoa/aws-lambda-manual/src/Models/AssessRequest.cs. Namespace MigrationFortuneManual.Models. Same structure as FEAT-001 model but NO Azure/Azure.Storage references — only System.Text.Json.Serialization for [JsonPropertyName]. Properties: WorkloadName (string?), Description (string?), TechStack (string[]?), YearsInProduction (int?).

3. Create /Users/koji/kiro2/atoa/aws-lambda-manual/src/Models/AssessmentResult.cs. Namespace MigrationFortuneManual.Models. Same 10 fields as FEAT-001 with camelCase [JsonPropertyName]. No Azure deps.

4. Create /Users/koji/kiro2/atoa/aws-lambda-manual/src/Services/FortuneEngine.cs. Namespace MigrationFortuneManual.Services. INDEPENDENT reimplementation — do not copy from azure-app. Same logic: method AssessmentResult Assess(AssessRequest req, string source, Random rng). Complexity with Legendary doubling, 6Rs, successProbability pool-of-59, fortune weights, all 16 divine advice strings verbatim (same as FEAT-001), GUID + ISO8601 timestamp, storagePath='assessments/{id}.json'.

5. Create /Users/koji/kiro2/atoa/aws-lambda-manual/src/Services/S3StorageService.cs. Namespace MigrationFortuneManual.Services. Constructor reads Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable('S3_BUCKET_NAME'). Uses Amazon.S3.AmazonS3Client (no-arg constructor uses default credential chain + region from env). Method SaveAsync(string id, AssessmentResult result): PutObjectRequest with BucketName=_bucketName, Key='assessments/{id}.json', ContentBody=JsonSerializer.Serialize(result), ContentType='application/json'. Method GetAsync(string id) → AssessmentResult?: GetObjectRequest; catch Amazon.S3.AmazonS3Exception where ErrorCode is 'NoSuchKey' or '404' → return null; read response body stream and deserialize.

6. Create /Users/koji/kiro2/atoa/aws-lambda-manual/src/Functions/AssessFunction.cs. Namespace MigrationFortuneManual.Functions. Add assembly attribute at top of file: [assembly: Amazon.Lambda.Core.LambdaSerializer(typeof(Amazon.Lambda.Serialization.SystemTextJson.DefaultLambdaJsonSerializer))]. Constructor: public AssessFunction() { _fortune=new FortuneEngine(); _s3=new S3StorageService(); } (Lambda instantiates via parameterless ctor). Handler method: public async Task<APIGatewayHttpApiV2ProxyResponse> HandleAsync(APIGatewayHttpApiV2ProxyRequest request, ILambdaContext context). X-Force-Seed: HTTP/2 headers are lowercase — request.Headers?.TryGetValue('x-force-seed', out string? seedHeader); bool hasSeed = seedHeader!=null && int.TryParse(seedHeader, out int seedVal); Random rng = hasSeed ? new Random(seedVal) : Random.Shared. Body: request.Body (may be base64 if IsBase64Encoded=true); handle: string body = request.IsBase64Encoded ? Encoding.UTF8.GetString(Convert.FromBase64String(request.Body)) : request.Body; deserialize with PropertyNameCaseInsensitive=true. Validation 400: same rules as FEAT-001. source='aws-lambda-manual'. Return APIGatewayHttpApiV2ProxyResponse{StatusCode=200/400, Body=JsonSerializer.Serialize(result/error), Headers=new Dictionary<string,string>{{"Content-Type","application/json"}}}.

7. Create /Users/koji/kiro2/atoa/aws-lambda-manual/src/Functions/GetAssessmentFunction.cs. Namespace MigrationFortuneManual.Functions. Parameterless constructor. Handler: public async Task<APIGatewayHttpApiV2ProxyResponse> HandleAsync(APIGatewayHttpApiV2ProxyRequest request, ILambdaContext context). Get id from request.PathParameters['id']. Call _s3.GetAsync(id). If null → 404 {error:'Assessment not found',id:id}. Else → 200 JSON result. DO NOT add assembly: LambdaSerializer here (it's already in AssessFunction.cs — adding it twice causes compile warning, once is enough).

8. Run build verification: DOTNET_ROOT=/opt/homebrew/opt/dotnet@8/libexec /opt/homebrew/opt/dotnet@8/libexec/dotnet build /Users/koji/kiro2/atoa/aws-lambda-manual/src/MigrationFortuneManual.csproj — must print 'Build succeeded.' Fix any errors before proceeding.

10. Create /Users/koji/kiro2/atoa/aws-lambda-manual/template.yaml. Use AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09', Transform: AWS::Serverless-2016-10-31. Globals: Function: Runtime: dotnet8, Architectures: [arm64], Environment: Variables: S3_BUCKET_NAME: !Sub 'atoa-poc-manual-${AWS::AccountId}'. Parameters: none needed. Resources: (a) AssessmentBucket (AWS::S3::Bucket): BucketName: !Sub 'atoa-poc-manual-${AWS::AccountId}', BucketEncryption: ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration with AES256, VersioningConfiguration: Status: Suspended, Tags: project=atoa-poc/variant=manual/env=dev/app=migration-fortune. (b) LambdaExecutionRole (AWS::IAM::Role): AssumeRolePolicyDocument trust lambda.amazonaws.com, ManagedPolicies: AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole, inline policy: s3access with PutObject+GetObject on arn:aws:s3:::atoa-poc-manual-${AWS::AccountId}/assessments/*. Tags: same. (c) AssessFunction (AWS::Serverless::Function): Handler: MigrationFortuneManual::MigrationFortuneManual.Functions.AssessFunction::HandleAsync, MemorySize: 512, Timeout: 30, Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn, Events: AssessApi: Api: (HttpApi v2) Path: /assess, Method: post. Tags. (d) GetAssessmentFunction (AWS::Serverless::Function): Handler: MigrationFortuneManual::MigrationFortuneManual.Functions.GetAssessmentFunction::HandleAsync, MemorySize: 256, Timeout: 10, Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn, Events: GetAssessmentApi: Path: /assessment/{id}, Method: get. Tags. (e) MigrationFortuneApi (AWS::Serverless::HttpApi): Tags. Outputs: ApiUrl (!Sub 'https://${MigrationFortuneApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/').
